# Exact harmonic-mixture sampling without a height gap

Status: new private construction; no independent acceptance or historical-priority claim.
The finite mathematical model is supplied, not inferred from a material.

## 1. Consequence and admitted model

The intended operation is a normalized independent equilibrium draw of a non-Gaussian
elastic field, including a nonconvex potential, without first estimating its height
relaxation time. This is a finite-graph result, not an infinite-volume local sampler.

Let G be a finite connected graph, with m>=1 edges and n>=2 vertices, and pin one height.
Write b_e in R^(n-1) for its oriented incidence columns. For x in {0,1}^m put

    k_e=1+(q-1)x_e,    L_x=sum_e k_e b_e b_e^T,    q>=1.

One can also add a fixed PSD grounding matrix to L_x. There are r independent
real field components conditional on x, with common edge conductances. The exact
joint density, with respect to counting measure on x and Lebesgue field measure, is

    prod_e p_e^x_e (1-p_e)^(1-x_e)
        exp[-(1/2) sum_e k_e ||b_e^T phi||^2],       0<p_e<1.

Consequently the field's edge potential is

    V_e(s)=-log[(1-p_e) exp(-||s||^2/2)+p_e exp(-q||s||^2/2)]

and the conductance marginal is

    mu(x) proportional prod_e p_e^x_e(1-p_e)^(1-x_e) det(L_x)^(-r/2).

All Gaussian integrations, the conductance representation, its attractive
single-site conditionals, and the transfer-current mechanism are established prior
(Buchholz, PTRF 2021, DOI 10.1007/s00440-020-01021-5). They are not the claimed new
step. The step below bounds the sum of influences at a common finite configuration
before taking a supremum, rather than exchanging those operations in Dobrushin's
entrywise criterion.

## 2. Conditional and monotonicity

Set rho=q-1. Given all other bits, let L_0 have edge e at its low value and put
R_e=b_e^T L_0^(-1)b_e. The determinant lemma gives

    h_e=P(x_e=1|x_-e)
       =p_e/[p_e+(1-p_e)(1+rho R_e)^(r/2)].                 (1)

Increasing any other conductance decreases R_e, so h_e increases. Thus a common
uniform single-site update preserves the coordinate order. This establishes the
monotone grand coupling required below, including arbitrary nonconstant p_e.

# A summed-current refinement (same operation)

This is an analytic refinement of PROOF Section 3, not another source or fitted case.
It strengthens the admitted contrast and independent-component range.

Keep the notation there, with k_f=u in [1,q] and all other conductances fixed.
The exact transfer-current identity, including an optional fixed PSD grounding term,
implies

    sum_(e!=f) R_ef(u)^2 <= R_ff(u)-u R_ff(u)^2.

Let s=R_ff(1) in [0,1]. Sherman--Morrison gives

    R_ff(u)=s/[1+(u-1)s].

Therefore

    integral_1^q sum_(e!=f) R_ef(u)^2 du
      <= (q-1)s(1-s)/[1+(q-1)s]
      <= (q-1)/(sqrt(q)+1)^2.

The last scalar maximum is attained at s=1/(sqrt(q)+1). Combining with the
already proved derivative bound (r(q-1)q/8)R_ef^2 gives

    c_sharp = r q(sqrt(q)-1)^2/8.                        (S1)

Thus c_sharp<1 is also a sufficient finite-graph CFTP condition. It is strictly
stronger than the initial rational c=r q(q-1)^2/8. For example, q=4,r=1 has
c_sharp=1/2, while the initial c would be 9/2 and would admit nothing. At q=2,
r=3 gives c_sharp=9/4-(3/2)sqrt(2)<13/100 rather than the initial 3/4.

The original code/window and executions deliberately retain the initial rational
constant unless an explicitly declared stronger rational qualifier is supplied.
This extension changes no existing sample bytes. Any rational c_bar satisfying
c_sharp<=c_bar<1 can be consumed without an irrational runtime decision.

This is still a finite global sampler. The calculation does NOT exchange a sum
with an entrywise supremum, prove infinite-volume uniqueness, remove the cost of
resolvent evaluation, or handle a linear force / nonzero-tilt Gibbs measure.

# Conditional continuous law and literal quantized output

PROOF gives an exact conductance draw. Its conditional field distribution is a
normalized Gaussian and must be paid, not treated as the already executed output.
The sibling quantized_field.py implements this completion using outward Arb.

For the rational positive-definite covariance C=L_x^(-1), an exact rational LDL
factorization gives C=T D T^T, with T unit lower triangular and D strictly positive.
Fresh independent Box--Muller pairs

    Z_1=sqrt(-2 log U) cos(2 pi V),
    Z_2=sqrt(-2 log U) sin(2 pi V)

give the required independent real normals. Each field component is T sqrt(D) Z.
The output is the componentwise floor on a SUPPLIED positive rational grid width.
It is the normalized full field law pushed through this quantizer, with the pinned
site omitted. It is not an exact finite string representing a continuous real.

Every U,V is a persistent lazy fair-bit interval. Increase its precision and use
outward elementary functions and arithmetic until every floor is unique. No
floating midpoint, accepted tolerance, Gaussian cutoff, or resampling of ambiguous
fields governs the result. The executable pseudorandom source is diagnostic only;
the probabilistic theorem assumes iid fair bits and correct outward operations.

For a fixed finite input, termination and finite expected requested precision can
be justified without assuming independent adaptive precisions. At depth p, exclude
U outside [2^(-p/3),1-2^(-p/3)] for ALL radial uniforms. This event has probability
O(nr 2^(-p/3)). On the complement the Box--Muller map has a deterministic derivative
bound growing at most O(poly(p) 2^(p/2)); input intervals of width 2^-p therefore
give exponentially shrinking field intervals, after charging the finite LDL norm.
Working precision can be enlarged to pay elementary rounding as well.

For each nonzero-variance marginal Gaussian X and fixed grid width delta, the
wrapped density sum sum_k f_X(k delta) is finite (and bounded, for example, by
1/delta+2 sup f_X). Therefore the probability that an output coordinate lies within
w of ANY grid boundary is at most O(w(1/delta+sup f_X)), with a harmless enlargement
of the constant for w<delta/4. Union over finitely many coordinates proves an
